changes: Hold LFO and turn a knob: that parameter becomes the LFO's destination; keep turning to set the depth.
With LFO held, pressing the destination's knob sets the depth back to 0.
An LFO tap opens the LFO page on the release, as FIX now toggles on the release.
Other mods that follow the page keys now see that LFO tap too.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: hold FIX and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity.
Hold SAMPLER and turn a knob to link it to aftertouch.
While held, linked knobs show their amounts like performance locks.
Uses the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots, so links save with the kit.
A FIX tap now toggles fixed velocity when you let go.
